reason: I already have my own bike and ride it everywhere, so I don't need to pay for someone else's. And in winter and rain I won't ride anyway, so a monthly pass makes no sense for me.
objection: With only 10 bikes in town I doubt one would even be near the station when I need it, and I'd be paying for something I already own.
would_change_my_mind: If my own bike got broken or stolen and a bike was reliably parked at the train station in the morning, I'd pay per ride for a while.
